Emergency Shutdown Procedure — Plant Section C

1. INITIATION
   Emergency shutdown may be initiated by:
   - Manual activation of the ESD button (red mushroom head, panel CP-003)
   - Automatic trip from the safety instrumented system (SIS)
   - Authorization from the shift supervisor or plant manager

2. VALVE ISOLATION
   Emergency shutdown procedure requires valve isolation of all process
   feeds within 30 seconds of ESD activation. The following valves must
   close automatically:
   - XV-C-001: Main feed isolation (fail-closed, pneumatic)
   - XV-C-002: Product outlet isolation (fail-closed, pneumatic)
   - XV-C-003: Utility steam isolation (fail-closed, pneumatic)
   - XV-C-004: Cooling water supply (fail-open — maintains cooling)

3. DEPRESSURIZATION
   After valve isolation, section C must be depressurized to below 2 bar
   within 15 minutes through the flare header. Blowdown valve BDV-C-001
   opens automatically on ESD activation.

4. NOTIFICATION
   The control room operator must notify:
   - Site emergency response team within 2 minutes
   - Environmental monitoring within 5 minutes
   - Plant management within 15 minutes

5. RESTART CLEARANCE
   Restart after emergency shutdown requires:
   - Root cause investigation completion
   - Written clearance from the shift supervisor
   - Verification of all safety instrumented functions
   - Pressure test of isolated sections
   - Management of change review if any modifications were made
